engine.notes: New York's long-form core is UCB, the PIT and Magnet within a few blocks of each other in Manhattan, with Brooklyn's BCC and Second City now matching them for volume; Queens, Staten Island, the Bronx and the New Jersey towns have classes and venues but no dedicated improv theater, and the Squirrel Comedy Theatre's site showed no events.

entries.name: Upright Citizens Brigade Theatre (UCB New York)
entries.summary: The long-form institution founded by Besser, Poehler, Roberts and Walsh, now at 242 E 14th Street with a nightly show calendar and the Improv 101-to-advanced training center.
entries.schedule: Shows most nights; Improv Jam every other Tuesday at 5:30pm, free
entries.reasons: Decades of history, a complete beginner-to-performer curriculum, a full show calendar and a free jam; the site blocks automated fetches but its own pages surfaced in search with October 2026 shows.

entries.name: The Peoples Improv Theater (The PIT)
entries.summary: Ali Farahnakian's theater and comedy school at 154 W 29th Street: improv, sketch and stand-up shows nightly, leveled improv classes, daily drop-ins and a jam almost every evening.
entries.schedule: Shows nightly; drop-in classes daily at 1:30pm; jams and open mics most nights ($5 cash)
signals: Improv Levels 1-4 plus Joy of Improv
entries.reasons: Over twenty years in Manhattan with the city's most frequent jams, a leveled curriculum with daily drop-ins and a schedule already showing October 2026.

entries.name: Magnet Theater
entries.summary: Long-form improv and sketch theater at 254 W 29th Street since 2005, home of the Megawatt ensemble nights and the Musical Circuit, with a training center running three core levels plus advanced study.
entries.schedule: Shows nightly; Musical Circuit most Thursdays 10:30pm; free community mixers
entries.reasons: Two decades at a permanent Chelsea address, a complete improv and musical curriculum, house-team show nights and a schedule current into late October 2026.

entries.name: Brooklyn Comedy Collective (BCC)
entries.summary: Brooklyn's performer-paid comedy theater, running about 30 productions a week across Eris, the Pig Pen and the DogHouse, with improv, musical improv, sketch, stand-up and clown classes year-round.
entries.schedule: Shows nightly; Jelly improv jam Wednesdays 8pm; fall classes start October 20-26, 2026
signals: Weekly Jelly jam plus queer and Spanish-language jams
Hosts the Fun & Dumb Improv Festival
entries.reasons: A busy multi-venue home, a full curriculum with October 2026 cohorts, weekly jams and the most show volume in Brooklyn; younger than the Manhattan theaters.

entries.name: The Second City New York
entries.summary: The Second City's Brooklyn outpost at 64 N 9th Street, opened 2024 with a Mainstage, a Black Box for student shows and a training center teaching Improv 1-5, musical improv and conservatory tracks.
entries.schedule: Fall 2026 terms run October to December; free community improv jams and open mics
signals: Free student, BIPOC and queer improv jams
entries.reasons: A brand with 65 years of standing and a complete curriculum already listing fall 2026 terms, in a purpose-built venue that is only two years old.

entries.name: New York Improv Theater (Eight Improv)
entries.summary: Walt Frasier's short-form company, playing its flagship show EIGHT IMPROV every Saturday afternoon at the Broadway Comedy Club since 2002, with improv classes for kids, teens and adults.
entries.schedule: EIGHT IMPROV Saturdays 3pm at 318 W 53rd St; teen fall classes from October 4, 2026
signals: Classes for kids, teens and adults
entries.reasons: A quarter-century of weekly short-form shows and current class dates, in a borrowed comedy-club room rather than a theater of its own.

entries.name: Improvolution
entries.summary: NYC's character-based improv school, female-founded in 2002, teaching from a one-session intro through Levels 1-3 and advanced work at 115 MacDougal Street, with student and company shows.
entries.schedule: Class dates announced by email (ClassFlash); intro, 4-session and 10-session courses
signals: First female-founded improv school in NYC
Intro, Launch Into Yes, Levels 1-3 and advanced
entries.reasons: Two decades of teaching with a clear ladder of levels, but no theater of its own and no class dates posted on the site at the time of checking.

entries.name: Asylum NYC
entries.summary: A 150-seat comedy theater at 123 E 24th Street programming stand-up, improv, sketch and musical comedy, including the improvised musical Shitzprobe; its former class program is no longer on the site.
entries.schedule: Shows weekly; Shitzprobe on select Mondays; calendar runs September to November 2026
signals: Improvised musical Shitzprobe on select Mondays
Sister venue of Boston's Improv Asylum
entries.reasons: A real theater with a current calendar and improv on it, but no training program now and a mixed bill where improv is one strand among several.

entries.name: Q.E.D. Astoria
entries.summary: Astoria's woman-owned arts space at 27-16 23rd Avenue, founded 2014 and under new ownership since 2025, hosting more than 100 events a month including comedy shows, open mics and an adult improv class.
entries.schedule: 100+ events a month; adult improv class listed in the fall 2026 catalogue
signals: Sold to Hannah Lieberman in March 2025
Adult improv class on the fall 2026 listings
Voted top NYC comedy venue by Time Out readers
entries.reasons: A durable neighborhood venue with a current catalogue, but improv is a small part of a wide program and class dates were not visible.

entries.name: The Armory Comedy
entries.summary: An indie comedy community founded in 2016 by Leah Evans at The Tank, 312 W 36th Street, producing a weekly house-team improv show, a monthly sketch show and formats like Straight to Video.
entries.schedule: Weekly house improv teams and monthly sketch teams at The Tank; dates on the schedule page
signals: Based at The Tank, a non-profit arts venue
entries.reasons: A steady indie home with house teams, but no training program of its own, no venue of its own and no dates visible on the schedule page when checked.

entries.name: The Barrow Group Acting School
entries.summary: A theater company's acting school at 520 8th Avenue offering a three-level improv track (Fundamentals, Scene Work, Long Form), drop-in improv classes and TBG Improv Saturdays community sessions.
entries.schedule: Improv I-III each term; drop-ins; TBG Improv Saturdays (next listed October 3)
signals: Part of an established Off-Broadway company
entries.reasons: A credible three-level track inside a respected acting school, but improv is a sideline, there are no shows and the dates sit on an external calendar.

entries.name: Face Off Unlimited (FOU)
entries.area: East Village, Manhattan (HQ in Astoria, Queens)
entries.summary: The company behind BATSU! runs a six-week Intro to FOU Improv and an ongoing advanced class at Kogame, 67 1st Avenue, with intro graduates performing at the house jam; its offices are in Astoria.
entries.schedule: BATSU! NYC runs weekly; class sessions announced by email
signals: Produces BATSU! in NYC and Chicago
Intro to FOU Improv (6 weeks) and ongoing class
Graduates perform at the house jam
entries.reasons: An established producer with a venue and a two-step class path, but no posted session dates and a program that is small beside its game-show business.

entries.name: Jersey Creative Lab (JCL)
entries.area: Hoboken and Jersey City, New Jersey
entries.summary: Formerly Jersey Improv Lab: four-week Intro to Improv and six-week Level 2 courses (with a graduation show) in downtown Hoboken and Jersey City, plus stand-up writing workshops.
entries.schedule: Fall 2026 workshops began September 14-20; Level 2 requires 12 hours of prior training
signals: Level 1 Intro (4 weeks) and Level 2 (6 weeks + grad show)
Sessions in Hoboken, Jersey City and North Brunswick
entries.reasons: The one verifiable improv school on the New Jersey side with current dates and a two-level path, but no theater, no shows and a short history.

entries.name: Brooklyn Improv Training (Letter of Marque Theater Co.)
entries.summary: Letter of Marque Theater Company's improv school teaching Fundamentals 1 and 2, a Level 3 and short focus workshops in Gowanus and Park Slope, with end-of-course showcases and scholarships for BIPoC and LGBTQIA+ students.
entries.schedule: Eight-session courses; all current sections listed as TBA
signals: Free tuition offered to BIPoC and LGBTQIA+ applicants
Classes at Vangeline Theater and Logan's Run
entries.reasons: A genuine leveled program with an inclusive tuition policy, but borrowed rooms, no public shows and every section marked TBA when checked.

entries.name: Chicago City Limits
entries.summary: New York's longest-running improv company, performing audience-inspired topical improv since the late 1970s and teaching a four-level adult curriculum, teen and kids classes and Improv4Business workshops.
entries.schedule: Shows booked at theaters, clubs and corporate venues; class dates by phone or email
signals: Performing in NYC for over 35 years
entries.reasons: Historic standing and a real curriculum, but no permanent stage, no posted dates and a site whose newest material is from 2020.
